fact: Article 32 of the new ordinance on social networks, as published in the Journal Officiel, prohibits sexual deepfakes of identifiable persons without consent, deepfakes attributing false statements to public figures, sexual depictions of minors and imitation of state institutions for disinformation, with immediate recourse to the emergency judge.
title: Gabon/Communication : encadrement strict de certains contenus générés par intelligence artificielle
